update.column: SELECT ml.id as "Préstamo", mc.name as "Seguro endosado", mc.insurer_name as "Insurer name", mc.insurance_company as "Nit aseguradora", TO_CHAR(mlc.expire_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as "fecha de vencimiento de la póliza" FROM m_loan ml INNER JOIN m_loan_charge mlc ON ml.id = mlc.loan_id INNER JOIN m_charge mc ON mlc.charge_id = mc.id WHERE (mc.insurance_company = '${insuranceCompany}' OR '${insuranceCompany}' = '-1') AND mlc.expire_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}'
